wearable.title: Wearable Device
wearable.introSubtitle: Begin the standardized Parkinson's Assessment. This will guide you through 3 movement tasks (1 minute each).

steps.restingDesc: Place your hands comfortably in your lap. Try to relax and remain as still as possible.
steps.posturalDesc: Stretch your arms straight out in front of you, palms facing down, and keep them level.
steps.kineticDesc: Slowly and repeatedly touch your index finger to your nose.

wearable.continueHint: Continue the task until the timer finishes.
wearable.verdictSubtext: Based on aggregate analysis of Resting, Postural, and Kinetic tasks.
wearable.connectPrompt: Connect your wearable to begin collecting movement data

protocol.title: Assessment Protocol
protocol.step1: Fasten the wearable securely to your wrist.
protocol.step2: After pressing Start, place your phone down on the table.
protocol.step3: Rest your hands completely still in your lap and relax.
protocol.step4: Wait for the assessment to complete (approx. 90 seconds). The result screen will appear automatically.

cognitive.title: Brain Health Check
cognitive.subtitle: Two short activities to check your thinking speed and attention.
cognitive.introNote: A short practice round comes before each activity.
cognitive.tmtInstrSub: Tap the dots in order — 1, then 2, then 3 — as quickly as you can.
cognitive.tmtInstrLabel: The dot you tap next glows green
cognitive.glowHint: The glowing dot is where to tap next
cognitive.tmtRestSub: Now the real activity — 25 dots. Tap them in order as quickly as you can.
cognitive.tmtRestNote: Take a breath whenever you're ready.
cognitive.breakSub: Well done. Take a moment to rest before the next activity.
cognitive.sdmtInstrSub: A symbol will appear. Tap the matching number from the key above.
cognitive.sdmtInstrNotePrac: 5 practice rounds first — you'll see if you're right.
cognitive.sdmtInstrNoteReal: 60 seconds. Go as fast as you can. Mistakes are okay.

success.title: All Done!
success.description: Your brain health check is complete. Results have been recorded.

cognitiveResults.summaryHealthy: Your results are healthier than %{pct}% of people assessed

cognitiveResults.whatThisMeansBody1: Your cognitive score places you at the
cognitiveResults.whatThisMeansBody5: in our clinical reference dataset. A lower percentile indicates patterns more consistent with healthy individuals.
cognitiveResults.interp1: Your score places you at the %{rank}th percentile against a baseline of over 4,000 adults. In this test, a lower percentile means your results are consistent with typical, healthy brain activity.
cognitiveResults.interp2: Your score places you at the %{rank}th percentile against a baseline of over 4,000 adults. Some patterns are slightly outside the typical range — this can be influenced by temporary factors like fatigue or stress.
cognitiveResults.interp3: Your score places you at the %{rank}th percentile against a baseline of over 4,000 adults. A few patterns are worth keeping an eye on. Regular retesting over time gives a much clearer picture.
cognitiveResults.interp4: Your score places you at the %{rank}th percentile against a baseline of over 4,000 adults. Some patterns detected here can sometimes appear in early neurological changes. We recommend speaking with a healthcare professional.
cognitiveResults.rec1: Your cognitive patterns look healthy. Keep mentally active with reading, puzzles, and regular sleep. Retake in 30 days to track over time.
cognitiveResults.rec2: Your results are within a monitoring range. Consider regular checkups and staying mentally active. Retake in 30 days for a clearer trend.
cognitiveResults.rec3: Your results suggest some patterns worth monitoring. Staying physically active and mentally engaged can help. Consider speaking with your doctor.
cognitiveResults.rec4: We recommend speaking with a qualified healthcare provider to discuss your results. This screening is a starting point, not a diagnosis.
cognitiveResults.disclaimerText1: This screening tool detects patterns associated with neurological risk. It does
cognitiveResults.disclaimerText2: diagnose any medical condition. Always consult a qualified healthcare professional for medical advice.
